study: AW-STUDY-0014 Cards v3: print-ready beautiful artifacts
source: midjourney.com/explore image search (Top; the Likes tab on this account is empty)
note: Images belong to their Midjourney authors; kept as study references only, not game assets.

picks.author: s.lug1989
picks.prompt: a row of 5 very slightly burnt playing card, black background
picks.why: A real playing card a child has coloured in with crayon, singed edges and all: it feels made by a hand, not a printer.

picks.author: lialialia
picks.prompt: a celestial card with embossed gold foil details lies on a smooth beige surface. the rectangular design features a dark green border filled with ornate gold scrollwork corners and edges. inside the frame, gold illustrations depict three main celestial bodies lined up vertically: a crescent moon at the top, a sun with a serene human face in the middle, and a cratered full moon at the bottom. small gold stars are scattered around the main elements on the cream paper background. natural directional light highlights the metallic shimmer and raised texture of the gold foil design.
picks.why: Letterpress and raised gold foil on thick cream stock in raking light: the card as a precious physical object.

picks.author: gotstyle
picks.prompt: a textured playing card showing the 3 of clubs with cute black and white kitten illustrations. in the upper left corner, a black number '3' sits above a small black club symbol. in the lower right corner, a upside down black number '3' sits below a small upside down black club symbol. in the upper right area, a striped standing kitten waters a potted club symbol using a watering can. in the center, a sitting white kitten holds a second black club symbol. a third black club symbol is centered near the bottom.
picks.why: Huge restraint: a plain card, a few ink kittens playing with the pips. Wit and white space instead of ornament.

picks.author: naomi101192
picks.prompt: whimsical simplified tarot card illustration featuring The Sun, a charming smiling sun with simple expressive face and clean radiating rays, a few tiny stars and sparkles, simple vintage-inspired tarot border, balanced symmetrical composition, warm cream tarot card, antique gold sun, dusty mauve and muted sage accents, muted plum details, deep charcoal linework, simple recognizable shapes, limited decorative details, clean medium-weight hand-drawn linework, flat 2D artwork, cohesive midnight magic color palette, whimsical magical mood, subtle vintage character, isolated motif, no background, no typography, no complicated ornament, no intricate details, no photorealism, no 3D, no gradients, no heavy shading, no watermark
picks.why: A chunky, rounded, kid-friendly card with a smiling sun: flat colour, soft palette, reads instantly at small size.

picks.author: Isas Ozuna
picks.prompt: Vintage 1909 Rider Waite Smith tarot card, "RAINHA DE ESPADAS." Crowned queen seated three quarter view on a carved grey stone throne above clouds. ... Early 20th century lithograph: thick uneven black contours, flat unmodulated color, limited palette, cross hatching, naive medieval figures ... (excerpt; the full prompt on the job page is 1024 characters)
picks.why: Flat unmodulated lithograph colour inside thick uneven ink lines, with a title banner: the 1909 deck look that still beats most modern cards.

picks.author: sidharth gehlot
picks.prompt: Karna gives away his golden armor to Indra disguised as a Brahmin, pain held beneath unwavering generosity, close ceremonial composition, muted gold and iron-grey oil, solemn morning radiance, no modern objects, no lettering.
picks.why: Reads like a two-colour risograph print: grainy coral sun, sky-blue field, paper showing through. Spot colour done right.

picks.author: bmaluna
picks.why: Folk-art screenprint in three spot colours with a dotted border: bold, symmetrical, unmistakably hand-made.

picks.author: dloffbeat
picks.prompt: hand drawn illustration of An Indonesian king with medium length black hair holding a cane, thin outline, blue and muted pink tones, minimal shading, clipart, joan of arc
picks.why: A face-card king redrawn as a modern block print: two colours, pattern as costume, no frame needed.

picks.author: lightandgoodness
picks.prompt: water colour illustration of Adab in Today's Digital World: Bringing prophetic manners to our screens
picks.why: Cobalt cut-paper tile pattern on a white margin, one orange accent: the card back as a precious textile.

picks.author: katlucker
picks.prompt: create a Christmas themed, whimsical scandi folk art illustration, with doves holding Christmas baubles. all elements should have folk art elements within them, and they should be kept all separate and not overlap. use pinks, greens, blues and reds for color palette.
picks.why: Scandinavian folk symmetry with a stitched dotted border: warm, giftable, the kind of card a child keeps in a tin.

picks.author: hevell
picks.prompt: "The Kermit" ; card framed in robert crumb style, tarot card
picks.why: Woodcut cross-hatching and a hand-lettered title on aged stock: a joke executed with total craft (character IP, reference only).

picks.author: shado2427
picks.prompt: A green surreal extraterrestrial plain of green monoliths and drifting spore clouds beneath twin moons
picks.why: Two-tone sage and cream screenprint with a cut-out border: proof a card can be a landscape poster in three inks.

picks.author: big o
picks.prompt: Tarot card, indie cartoon style, thin ink outlines, noodle limbs, dot eyes, speckled paper, rounded black border, small tab at the top reading "I". A tall woman gambler with a beehive hairdo leaning over a dice table, the dice piling into a bell curve. Mint, mustard and pink. Lettering below reading "DATA SCIENCE"
picks.why: Closest to an Abbie's World hand card: rounded black border, colour bands, tiny title, cute character, speckled paper.

picks.author: kunsou
picks.prompt: A heartwarming diptych watercolor illustration featuring the texture of rough Xuan paper and soft macaron hues. This cartoon-style artwork depicts a fair-skinned 10-year-old girl with long black hair and bright eyes; she wears a dark yellow zip-up hoodie and black shorts while sitting atop a massive pink creature. ... (excerpt, first 500 characters)
picks.why: Risograph-grain children's-book card with a hand-lettered edge: a child-hero-scale story in one frame.

picks.author: .arperture
picks.why: A worn card held between fingers on a wooden table: scale, thickness and wear make a single image feel treasured.

picks.author: AntSengelli
picks.prompt: ancient chinese han dynasty era tradingcard game template
picks.why: A place card: flat-colour architecture vignette in a lacquer-red frame with blank title and rules boxes, the right shape for a Ranch tile card.
